request.style: English, melancholic female solo voice, piano, cello, soft drums, reverb, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Amon was twenty-two when he took the throne
Reigned two years in Jerusalem alone
His mother Meshullemeth from Jotbah came
He walked in the paths of his father's name

[Verse]
He did what was evil in the eyes of the LORD
Serving the idols his father adored
He bowed down to them in the dust
He forsook the God of his fathers just

[Chorus]
His officials conspired in the house of the king
They struck down the ruler and silenced the ring
The people of the land rose up in fear
They made Josiah king while the shadows appear

[Verse]
They struck down all who had conspired that day
To keep the kingdom from slipping away
He was buried in his tomb deep below
In the garden of Uzza where the winds blow

[Chorus]
His officials conspired in the house of the king
They struck down the ruler and silenced the ring
The people of the land rose up in fear
They made Josiah king while the shadows appear

[Outro]
Josiah succeeded him on the throne
In the garden of Uzza all is known
